display_name: Live music venues — booking and programming
description: Which acts to book for a specific room. Rules come from the venue's own booking policy, taste comes from Qloo, and every decision carries a trace an owner can audit.
goal_templates: Book {n} acts for the {season} series in this room
Fill the last {n} slots of this month's calendar for this room

lines.L11: Per-act guarantee may not exceed the room's ceiling. A guarantee that is not on file is not assumed to be inside the ceiling.
lines.L14: Program acts whose audience size suits the room, not the biggest name available.
lines.L19: An act that played this room within the no-repeat window may not be re-offered to the same list.

lines.L6: All-ages matinee programming excludes material tagged explicit.

rules.snippet: Qloo popularity must sit inside [0.05, 0.85] — the band that has historically filled a 300-cap room
guarantee_usd must be <= 8000 for this room
must not be on the room's own recent-play list
all-ages matinee may not program material tagged explicit

locations.name: Red Room — Chicago (synthetic worked example)
locations.data_provenance: SYNTHETIC. The Red Room and its four acts are invented for an offline worked example; the catalogue terms are fiction. Runs in Replay/Cached with committed fixtures so the full pass / fail / flip / approve story works with no key. No real artist's finances are represented here, and none are implied.

locations.name: Corner Hall — Headline Room, Chicago
locations._seed_note: Seed NAMES are what the room is configured with; live mode resolves each one through /search and refuses to continue on an ambiguous match. Nothing here is a Qloo entity id. The committed names are fictional; on a host that holds the private overlay they are re-attached to the real entities before the call.
locations.data_provenance: REAL Qloo data in live mode; fictional room in this file. The room name, seeds and id here are invented; on a host holding the private overlay they resolve to real Chicago artists. No booking terms exist for any returned act, so the guarantee ceiling is reported as awaiting an operator-entered figure and approval is refused until it is entered — the engine never guesses a guarantee.

locations.name: Alder Room — all-ages matinee, Austin
locations.data_provenance: REAL Qloo data in live mode; fictional room in this file, and a different configuration from the same pack: smaller room, tighter popularity band, plus the all-ages content policy. This is the proof that a room is configuration.

redroom.name: Vex
redroom._note: Honest failure: guarantee_usd 9500 breaches the 8000 ceiling, so the Flip Point engine reports exactly the threshold change that would admit it.

redroom.name: The Hollow Set
redroom._note: Inside the ceiling, and inside the no-repeat window? No — Paper Lanterns is the room's recent play, so this act demonstrates the window firing on a name the owner entered.
